# Omar Farook on Instagram: "We’re live on @producthunt today. Granular is an AI workspace for visionary builders. Bring your own…"

We’re live on @producthunt today.

Granular is an AI workspace for visionary builders. Bring your own agents: a boss agent hires workers on Claude, Codex, Gemini and more, each with access to all the tools they need: terminals, web preview, markdown and code editors, 1400+ connectors, key vault, local files, skills, plugins and more. 

Your project becomes a living brain, with a roadmap your agents work from. Missing a tool? Build it as a plugin. Every creative asset sits on one canvas, and any workflow becomes one skill.

Get started for Free on Mac and Windows. Launch week only: Pro is 50% off with code LEGENDARY50, until 30 November. [...] If you build with AI agents, we’d love your support and your honest feedback on Product Hunt today. Comment below and we’ll DM you the link.
